exp-tar: It extracts (unpacks) the gzip-compressed archive backup.tar.gz into /tmp.
exp-find-delete: It finds files ending in .log that are older than 7 days and deletes them. Be careful: -delete cannot be undone.
exp-ps-pipeline: It lists every process, sorts by the memory column from highest to lowest and shows the top five.
exp-chmod: It sets the permissions of the current directory and everything below it (recursively) to 755.
exp-awk-sum: It adds up the third column of data.txt and prints the total at the end.
exp-rm-warning: It deletes every file and folder inside ~/projects, without asking. The deletion is permanent, so be very careful.
ask-service-boot:
Enable the unit with systemctl:
```shellmate-command
sudo systemctl enable nginx
```
ask-ssh-publickey: The server rejected your ssh key: it has no matching public key for you, or your key is not loaded.
ask-port-owner:

```shellmate-command

```
ask-undo-commit:
A soft reset moves HEAD back and keeps your changes staged:
```shellmate-command
git reset --soft HEAD~1
```
